list_functions: list all functions available in the open-webui system for the verified user
create_new_function: create a new open-webui function with id, name, type, and python content from a form payload
update_function_by_id: update an existing open-webui function by its id with new content and metadata
delete_function_by_id: delete an open-webui function by its id and remove it from the in-memory cache
update_function_valves: update the admin-level valves configuration for a specific open-webui function by id
